deviations: Commands are yamakan.story.save, yamakan.pack.save and yamakan.story.assemble (command namespaces are lowercase); shots are edited through the story document, not a separate shot command

Workspace schema 13 rebuilds creative_documents and document_uploads to accept the new kinds and adds story_document_versions; an earlier build refuses a v13 workspace, so going back needs a backup from before the upgrade (as with YU-013's v12); no automatic pre-upgrade backup is taken
Redo of an assembly restores that timeline without re-checking consents (the clips are project media); consumers of a likeness reference must check consent at use (assertConsentUsable)
Story and pack saves are inline (not staged), bounded by the document storage budget, 32 documents per project and the revision limit
The Director panel lists stories and packs read-only; assembly and editing are commands (CLI, SDK, agents, REST/MCP)
core/director/runtime.ts is donor-derived; its assertConsentUsable addition is recorded in imports.json
